asset.name: Layer Manager
asset.description: The global coordinator for portals, stacking order, modal isolation, nested overlays, inert background content, focus restoration, and reference-counted scroll locking.

requires.reason: Stacking order is assigned from the declared layer ramp rather than ad hoc z-index values.

rationale: Two independent layer managers in one application is the defect that produces dialogs behind their own backdrops, and it is detectable by the adoption scanner.
